target_customer: European consumers paying for preventive blood testing memberships
problem: People lack regular, interpretable blood biomarker testing; Lucis turns tests into doctor reviewed action plans.
business_model: Annual membership with biomarker panels and AI coach (site shows 199 euros per year; FrenchWeb reported 490 euros)

founders.name: Max Berthelot
founders.background_notes: About a decade in biohacking per YC launch post

founders.name: Baptiste Debever
founders.background_notes: Described as repeat founder; prior startups not named

founders.name: Max G.
founders.background_notes: Named only in the YC launch post; surname and role not stated

competitors.name: Function Health
competitors.what: US membership for regular blood testing, named by Lucis as its model

technical_complexity.rationale: Mainly operations: lab partnerships, physician review and an app; AI analysis is an add on.

defensibility.rationale: Longitudinal biomarker data and lab network help, but US peers and local labs can enter Europe.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: US peers expanded and Europe saw entrants; Lucis raised a Series A in 2026-05.

market_need_then: Function Health style memberships had proven US demand and Europe lacked equivalents; Lucis reports over 10,000 users per press.

identity.logo: Logo described by one article as a woman's silhouette; press kit offers black, white, light and dark variants

brand_strength.rationale: Press kit and funding coverage exist, but no evidence the brand itself drove growth; name origin not found.

outcome_analysis: Lucis copied a proven US model for Europe, raised an $8.5M seed in December 2025 and a $20M Series A in May 2026, and reports over 10,000 users. Speed of fundraising and execution are strong signals, while regulation, pricing and US entrants are the main risks.
notes: Seed lead is disputed across sources (General Catalyst versus Y Combinator and Motier Ventures); investors listed are those named by multiple outlets. Series A confirmed by company blog and The Next Web, a EUR 17.3M figure is the same raise in euros. Competition list uses the company's own comparison; no dated third party competitor coverage near the batch found. Founders' education not found.
